plugins.name: megascenes
plugins.description: Images, videos, voice-overs and music from 140+ models (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs) in one place, with the exact price before every run. Generated in your MegaScenes account.

plugins.name: image
plugins.description: Create images from a description: photos, pictures, illustrations, art, characters and scenes in any aspect ratio. Generated in seconds and saved to your MegaScenes library.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Create short video clips from a description of the scene and camera: reels, TikToks, shorts, ads, intros and stories. Generated with Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan and more.

plugins.name: logo-maker
plugins.description: Logo maker: design logo concepts from your brand name, business, style and colors. Up to four options per run, generated as image files you can download.

plugins.name: image-to-video
plugins.description: Image to video: animate a photo or picture from your MegaScenes library into a short clip with the motion and camera move you describe, generated in a few minutes.

plugins.name: video-editor
plugins.description: Video editor: edit a video from your MegaScenes library with a prompt. Restyle it, swap objects or the background, reframe it to 9:16 or 1:1, extend it with new footage, or lip-sync it to a voice track.

plugins.name: text-to-speech
plugins.description: Text to speech: turn a script into natural voice-overs and narration in many voices and languages, generated as audio files for videos, ads, podcasts and audiobooks.

plugins.name: music
plugins.description: Create original background music and soundtracks from a description of genre, mood, instruments and tempo, generated as audio files for videos, podcasts, games and ads.

plugins.name: sound-effects
plugins.description: Sound effects generator: describe a whoosh, footsteps, rain ambience, foley or a UI click and get the SFX file generated in seconds, for videos, games, apps and podcasts.

plugins.name: image-upscaler
plugins.description: Image upscaler: enlarge, enhance and sharpen an image from your MegaScenes library to 2x or 4x for print, wallpapers and 4K screens. The larger file is generated in seconds.

plugins.name: poster
plugins.description: Poster and flyer maker: event posters, flyers, sale announcements and menus generated with your headline and details spelled out correctly.

plugins.name: sticker-maker

plugins.name: emoji-maker

plugins.name: pixel-art-maker

plugins.name: tattoo-generator

plugins.name: character-creator

plugins.name: avatar-maker

plugins.name: meme

plugins.name: thumbnail-maker

plugins.name: coloring-page-maker

plugins.name: song

plugins.name: beat

plugins.name: book-cover-maker

plugins.name: photo-editor
